costEstimateUsd.source: Azure Retail Prices API, eastus2, USD
costEstimateUsd.retained: Foundry resource, project, guardrail, blocklist, and a GlobalStandard model deployment bill per token only, so idle cost is zero. The Log Analytics workspace bills per GB ingested; a rehearsal ingests well under 1 MB.
costEstimateUsd.bounded: API Management Basic v2 bills 0.21 USD per unit hour whether or not traffic flows, plus calls beyond the included 10 million. Deploy it for a rehearsal or take and remove it afterward.
costEstimateUsd.perRun: One full demo run sends roughly 20 model calls of a few hundred tokens each, a fraction of a cent at gpt-4.1-mini token rates. Defender for AI Services bills per 1,000 tokens scanned, again a fraction of a cent per run; on a new subscription it started a 30-day trial on 2026-11-04.
costEstimateUsd.notes: Retail estimate before credits and tax. Missing billing rows don't prove zero cost.
